description: This Java class 'GLAccountBuilder' provides a builder pattern for constructing JSON representations of GL (General Ledger) account objects with various configurations such as account type, usage, and permissions. It is used for testing or setup purposes within the Apache Fineract integration tests.

classes.name: GLAccountBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to generate JSON strings for GL account objects with various configurable properties.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JSON string representing a GL account with current builder settings.

methods.name: withAccountTypeAsAsset
methods.description: Sets account type as Asset and generates a unique GL code.

methods.name: withAccountTypeAsLiability
methods.description: Sets account type as Liability and generates a unique GL code.

methods.name: withAccountTypeAsAsEquity
methods.description: Sets account type as Equity and generates a unique GL code.

methods.name: withAccountTypeAsIncome
methods.description: Sets account type as Income and generates a unique GL code.

methods.name: withAccountTypeAsExpense
methods.description: Sets account type as Expense and generates a unique GL code.

methods.name: withName
methods.description: Sets a custom name for the account, appending a random suffix if the name is not blank.

methods.name: withMaualEntriesNotAllowed
methods.description: Configures the account to disallow manual entries.
